note: Single-pass extraction by Claude reading the paper text; evidence references sections/figures/tables. No multi-run validation.

components.description: Book-scale coreference gap -> annotation pipeline -> BookCoref resources -> benchmark findings

nodes.name: Annotating long texts is costly
nodes.description: Manually annotating coreference gets harder with document length because annotators resolve mentions incrementally using prior context, so existing benchmarks use short or truncated documents (OntoNotes averages 467 tokens; LitBank truncates to 2,000 tokens).

nodes.name: No book-scale CR benchmark
nodes.description: Existing long-document resources (LongtoNotes under 700 tokens/doc, MovieCoref 9 screenplays, Animal Farm) do not provide a book-scale coreference benchmark with training data.

nodes.name: Generative/encoder CR don't scale to books
nodes.description: Seq2seq generative CR doubles context length, and encoder-only models such as Maverick (DeBERTa-v3, up to 25,000 tokens) have quadratic cost, making whole-book processing impractical.

nodes.name: Character-only annotation
nodes.description: BookCoref annotates only characters, the main agents of fictional stories, following MovieCoref and Animal Farm guidelines.

nodes.name: Character Linking init
nodes.description: Character clusters are initialized by Character Linking, a ReLiK entity-linking model fine-tuned on a manually amended LitBank, linking explicit mentions to character names; it gets 44.5 F1 vs 29.2 for pattern matching.

nodes.name: LLM cluster refinement
nodes.description: Qwen2 7B Instruct verifies each linked mention with a Yes/No prompt and filters negatives, raising character-linking precision by an average +5.2 points.

nodes.name: Windowed cluster expansion
nodes.description: Maverick is applied to non-overlapping 1,500-word windows to expand character clusters to pronouns and noun phrases, but fails when a window lacks an explicit mention of a character.

nodes.name: Grouping step with Maverick-xl
nodes.description: Merging G=10 consecutive windows and running a second expansion with Maverick-xl on the grouped windows recovers missed mentions and raises CoNLL-F1 to 80.5 on BookCoref-gold.

nodes.name: Pipeline matches human agreement
nodes.description: The silver pipeline achieves MUC 93.3, comparable to inter-annotator MUC of 96.1 on BookCoref-gold, LitBank 95.5 and OntoNotes 83.0.

nodes.name: BookCoref-gold test set
nodes.description: BookCoref-gold has three fully manually annotated books (Animal Farm, Siddhartha, Pride and Prejudice; 229k tokens), annotated by three expert annotators over about 120 hours.

nodes.name: BookCoref-silver scale
nodes.description: BookCoref-silver has 50 books, 10.8M tokens and 968k mentions (avg 216,626 tokens per document), with 6.75x the tokens and 5x the mentions of OntoNotes, and mention-pair distance averaging 73,432 tokens.

nodes.name: Training on silver boosts models
nodes.description: Training on BookCoref-silver improves every system on book-scale gold; Longdoc rises from 46.6 to 67.0 CoNLL-F1 (+20.4) and is best on full books.

nodes.name: Book-scale much harder than windows
nodes.description: Systems score far higher on 1,500-token windows (Maverick-xl 82.2 CoNLL-F1) than on full books (Maverick-xl 61.0), showing the gap reflects open book-scale challenges, not just missing training data.

isolated_nodes.name: Longdoc most efficient
isolated_nodes.description: Longdoc has the lowest inference time and memory on BookCoref-gold (26 s and 5.8 GB after training on silver), vs Dual cache 473 s and 11.8 GB.

isolated_nodes.name: Metrics diverge at book scale
isolated_nodes.description: MUC often exceeds 80 F1 on both windows and full books, while B3 and especially CEAF-phi4 drop sharply on full books, showing the need for more robust CR metrics at book scale.

isolated_nodes.name: Dual cache underperforms after fine-tuning
isolated_nodes.description: Dual cache, previously considered best for long-document CR, scores lower after fine-tuning than Maverick-xl on full books.

isolated_nodes.name: Prior best on Animal Farm was 36%
isolated_nodes.description: Dual cache reached only 36% CoNLL-F1 on Animal Farm, far below averages on medium-sized datasets, while Longdoc trained on silver gets 67.5 there (+31.2).

structural_reasoning: Argument runs from the lack of annotated long-document data, through the three-step annotation pipeline, to the resulting gold/silver datasets and benchmark findings.
